brief:
An Israeli air strike killed two Palestinians, including a child, in the al-Nasr neighborhood of western Gaza City on Sunday, Middle East Eye reported. The strike targeted a civilian car in the densely populated residential area, according to local sources who confirmed the fatalities.

The incident marked the latest in a series of Israeli aerial operations across Gaza. No Israeli statement on the strike was immediately available, and details surrounding the circumstances of the attack remained limited as military operations continued in the territory.
